scope: Linux system power-profile service and complete-user-fan-curve minimum-duty source candidate. PPD live-service behavior, actual package deployment and native/hardware fan acceptance are separate.

implemented.ppd_discovery: Real native /sys only: prefer modern org.freedesktop.UPower.PowerProfiles, then legacy net.hadess.PowerProfiles only if modern is unowned. ACPI fallback requires both names explicitly absent and stable bus identity; query errors, untrusted owners, malformed responses and authority changes do not fall through. Fixtures do not query a live system bus.
implemented.ppd_binding: Bind system-bus ID, unique owner, endpoint, UID0, active profile, all advertised profile metadata, holds and degradation metadata; revalidate around queries and again before apply. Evidence source linux_power_profiles_daemon; PowerPolicy/ProfilePlan.details and ApplyResult.receipt retain their separate meanings.
implemented.ppd_apply: Same-profile no-op submits no setter. Otherwise at most one explicit ActiveProfile Set followed by independent observation. Holds may be released before activation fails; no automatic retry, old-profile rollback or reconstruction of application holds. Submitted errors preserve primary/readback errors and unknown/writer_may_continue even if a later observation sees the target.
implemented.legacy_os_recovery: ACPI/Windows direct profile transactions retain primary errors and conditionally recover only when fresh observations still identify this transaction target. Previous/foreign/unknown/changed state is not overwritten; recovery is read back. No global OS CAS or same-value ABA guarantee. This contract is separate from PPD holds semantics.
implemented.cli: profile balanced|performance|power-saver [--expected-current RAW] [--dry-run]. Exact raw name/GUID guard rejects before setter on mismatch; dry-run only observes/plans. Output failure retains completed result/error without repeating a setter.
implemented.gui: Display service provenance, degradation, holds, explicit preview/Apply and typed receipt/error. Refresh preserves earlier uncertainty. New explicit preview/apply can express new intent; no automatic retry. Closing waits for actual local in-flight work/worker exit, not forever on remote-writer uncertainty.
implemented.minimum_fan_output: Validated complete user curve only; independently optional CPU/GPU integer floors 1..100, default None. Raise only lower selected duty bytes, preserve temperatures and unselected channels. Zero bytes remain unless --raise-stopped-stages is explicit and at least one channel floor is provided. Output percent is not RPM, vibration threshold or thermal/acoustic qualification.
implemented.fan_gui_handoff: Controls do not alter the curve until Apply to draft; editing invalidates old preview, then normal preview/explicit apply and original exclusive lease/raw-table restore remain required. A lower later floor does not undo earlier draft increases. No model whitelist expansion.
